textGeneralInfo: The protection of your personal data is of particular concern to us. We treat your personal data confidentially and in accordance with statutory data protection regulations and this privacy policy.
captionDataCollection: 3. Collection and Storage of Personal Data
textDataCollectionIntro: We collect and store personal data when you create a user account and use our platform.
textDataCollectionListIntro: This includes in particular the following data:
dataCollectionItemProfilePicture: Profile picture (if provided, used exclusively for displaying your profile)
dataCollectionItemUsageInfo: Information about your use of the platform (e.g. created blogs and posts)
textDataCollectionRequired: The provision of certain data is required to use our platform, in particular to create and manage a user account.
textDataCollectionOptional: Optionally provided data (e.g. profile picture, date of birth or address) serves to personalize your profile and is voluntary.
textStorageActive: Your data is stored for as long as your user account is active.
textStorageDeletionRequest: If you request the deletion of your account, your account will first be marked as "scheduled for deletion". Final deletion will occur within 14 days.
textStorageRecovery: During this period, account recovery is possible.
textDataPurposeIntro: Your data is processed for the following purposes:
dataPurposeItemPlatform: Provision and operation of the platform
dataPurposeItemBlogContent: Display and publication of blog content
dataPurposeItemSecurity: Ensuring the security of the application
textAuthenticationJwt: For authentication we use JSON Web Tokens (JWT). These are used to uniquely identify you during your session.
textAuthenticationStorage: Storage currently takes place in the user's browser (e.g. local storage or cookies).
textDataDisclosureIntro: Your personal data will generally not be passed on to third parties, unless:
dataDisclosureItemConsent: or you have given your explicit consent
